card.name: Present-day time words in web prose
card.fires_on: Words that mark the present state of something, such as today, now, still, remains, and been after has/have, right after the subject or an auxiliary verb in general web text.

modes.label: Today/now/still
modes.description: An adverb of present time contrasting the current state with the past.
modes.example: it<< now>> takes an average of only 45

modes.label: Present-perfect or state verbs
modes.description: A verb such as been, remains, or is following a subject, describing a continuing status.
modes.example: This archived Web page<< remains>> online for reference, research or recordkeeping

card.plain: It lights up on words like today, now, still and been that describe how things stand at present.
